title: The Contest Contract — contest.yaml manifest
description: v1.0. The shell of one contest. See CONTRACT.md at the repo root for the full human spec; this schema is the machine contract derived from it. Strict mode: additionalProperties is false at every level. Receipts (holdings/weights/rationales/thesis) live in submissions/*.md, NEVER in this file.

spec_version.description: Which version of the Contest Contract this manifest is authored against. The validator-selection key.

id.description: Stable PK + repo path + URL fragment. Must equal the manifest's own directory (contests/{id}/).

category.description: The category discriminant — selects scorer + extensions schema. v1.0 ships portfolio only; others are reserved.

series.description: The repeatable FORMAT slug that carries year-over-year records (july-4, portfolio-foundations). null only for a sealed one-off. Must stay consistent with cadence.

edition.description: The run's display name. Free text.

season.description: DERIVED from open_date vs the Nov-30 platform epoch. OMIT this field unless the derived season disagrees with the editorial filing — the rare reset-straddle override.

scoring_kind.description: How winners are determined. v1.0 ships objective-automated only; others validate but their scorers are reserved.

lifecycle_kind.description: The shape of competition over time. v1.0 ships continuous only. 'recurring' is NOT a value here — recurrence lives in series + cadence.

roster_mode.description: Where competitors come from. closed = named up front. open = entrants arrive via submissions. products = curated SaaS/products.

interaction.description: Do competitors affect each other? parallel = independent same-conditions. adversarial = head-to-head play.

cadence.description: Does the format repeat, and how often? one-off pairs with series:null; any repeating cadence pairs with a non-null series.

open_date.description: The buy/start date. Governs season derivation. The day-0 baseline.

close_date.description: The end date. Must be >= open_date (runtime-validated). Drives duration and the progress bar — both derived.

submission_window_close.description: Author ONLY for lifecycle_kind: episodic (where it is required). Omit for every other contest.

voting_window_open.description: Reserved. Author only for a subjective/hybrid scoring_kind. null for objective contests.

voting_window_close.description: Reserved. Pairs with voting_window_open under the same rules.

rank.description: The cross-cutting ranking contract — the shared leaderboard reads it generically.

direction.description: Sort order of the score. desc = higher wins. asc = lower wins (e.g. a Brier score).

tie_breakers.description: Ordered fallback keys on a tie. Token set is category-specific — portfolio accepts only sharpe and max_drawdown (enforced in the category-conditional branch).

roster.description: Competitors by contestant-id (FKs into contestants.yaml). Required non-empty for closed/products; must be empty for open.

snapshots.description: Per-contestant version metadata. Omit if the submission _TEMPLATE.md frontmatter already carries normalized version/model_string keys. Otherwise write one entry per roster id.

prize.description: Display-only prize name ("Hall of Picks"). Reserved.

visibility.description: The only authored state knob. private = admin preview only. public = listed publicly (the live/coming-soon/closed state then derives from dates).

extensions.description: Category-specific block. Shape is determined by `category` (see the allOf branches below).

allOf.$comment: §9.5 / §11 — closed and products rosters must be non-empty
§11 — series + cadence must agree (one-off iff series:null)
§11 — series + cadence must agree (repeating cadence requires non-null series)
Reserved — category-conditional extensions: song. Placeholder; fields firm up the first time a song contest enters planning.

capital.description: Paper dollars per portfolio. Must equal the figure in rules.md. Every contest so far is 10000; a non-10000 value is accepted but loud-warned.

universe_path.description: Relative filename of the tradable list.

layers_path.description: Relative filename of the per-contest layer taxonomy.

sector_taxonomy.description: Controls the universe's optional Sector column. soft = universe.md has a Sector column feeding the advisory buckets. none = no Sector column.

universe_size.description: Optional checksum. If set, the loader asserts this equals the parsed Ticker-row count of universe.md.

position_min.description: Minimum number of names a portfolio may hold.

position_max.description: Maximum number of names. Must be >= position_min (runtime-validated).

weight_sum_tolerance.description: Sigma of holding weights must equal 100.0 plus or minus this.

price_source.description: Market-data provider. alpaca is the only legal value today.

price_feed.description: iex = the free IEX feed. sip = the consolidated/paid feed.

price_adjustment.description: raw = unadjusted closes. split_div = split/dividend-adjusted (requires the adjusted pipeline).

benchmarks.description: Vs-the-market context lines. Do NOT affect rank.

metric.description: Declares WHAT is scored. rank.direction (top level) declares HOW to order it.

primary.description: Closed literal — total_portfolio_value is the only accepted value today.

clarifications_path.description: Optional relative path to a results/clarifications.md (e.g. reasoning-time data).

rebalance.description: Turnover windows. ABSENT = buy-and-hold = exactly one period (index 0) per contestant.

schedule.description: Ordered list of rebalance events. Each date must satisfy open_date < date <= close_date and the list must be strictly ascending (runtime-validated).

caps.description: Turnover cap per RebalanceKind. Keys are monthly|quarterly|annual.

oneOf.description: Display-only synthetic benchmark (never priced, never ranked).

turnover_cap.description: Maximum percentage of portfolio value that may turn over at this rebalance tier.

songExtensions.$comment: Reserved — placeholder. Real fields land when a song contest enters planning. Kept loose for now (allows future fields without a schema break).
